name: mnemonic_aberration_weaver_ai
label: The Aberration Weaver
godotFeature: ShaderMaterial + Custom Fragment Shaders combined with runtime Resource property manipulation and dynamic Node3D transformation.
poeticVision: Feel a cold dread as the very fragments you fought to reclaim begin to unravel, twisting into grotesque parodies of their former selves. Their vibrant colors bleed into sickly hues, their textures warp, and their meaning warps with them. You're not just losing memories; you're watching them become alien, weaponized against you, forcing you to fight not just for your life, but for the fundamental truth of your past, which this entity is literally rewriting before your eyes.

parameters.name: corruption_radius
parameters.description: The radius around the Weaver within which memory fragments will be corrupted.

parameters.name: corruption_rate
parameters.description: The speed at which memory fragments visually and narratively degrade per second.

parameters.name: max_corruption_level
parameters.description: The maximum corruption level (0.0 to 1.0) at which a fragment transforms into a hostile entity.

parameters.name: hostile_mesh
parameters.description: The Mesh resource to use for the hostile entity created when a memory fragment is fully corrupted.

parameters.name: hostile_material
parameters.description: The Material resource to use for the hostile entity created when a memory fragment is fully corrupted.

parameters.name: corruption_shader
parameters.description: The Shader resource (`.gdshader` file) used to apply visual corruption effects to memory fragments.

dependencies: res://shaders/corruption_shader.gdshader (or similar path, containing the GLSL code provided in usage)
MemoryFragment MeshInstance3D nodes must be in the 'memory_fragments' group.
Optional: A custom 'MemoryResource' class with `start_corruption()`, `complete_corruption()`, `stop_corruption()` methods for narrative corruption.
verdict: The Aberration Weaver masterfully weaponizes the very essence of self-loss, transforming the player's past into a relentless, physical adversary.
impact: This mechanic will fundamentally alter the player's relationship with memory fragments. They are no longer just collectibles or resources; they become potential liabilities, ticking time bombs that can turn into direct threats. This introduces a constant layer of dread and urgency, forcing players to make difficult risk-reward decisions: do I try to save this memory, knowing it might become an enemy, or do I abandon it and lose a piece of myself? It transforms the act of memory recovery into a desperate race against internal corruption, making every retrieved fragment a hard-won victory against a self-betraying past.
